verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Customer.io exposing its own MCP server so external AI tools can call into Customer.io (docs-27, docs-9/10, probe-3) and a CLI for agents to access the workspace (docs-26) — this is Customer.io acting as an MCP server/tool provider, not as an MCP client that plugs in and uses external MCP servers' tools. Despite Customer.io having its own agent features (docs-31 to docs-34) that could plausibly consume external tools, no evidence shows it can add/connect third-party MCP servers to extend its own agent's capabilities.
